thread.title: Qualcomm accuses Apple of trade-secret theft: reports

author: morningstar.com
title: Qualcomm accuses Apple of trade-secret theft: reports
text:
Qualcomm Inc. (QCOM) has accused Apple Inc. (AAPL) of stealing trade secrets and giving them to rival Intel Corp. (INTC), according to reports (https://www.cnbc.com/2018/09/25/qualcomm-accuses-apple-of-giving-its-chip-secrets-to-intel.html) from CNBC and Reuters. The reports cite a Qualcomm legal filing. According to Reuters (https://www.reuters.com/article/us-apple-qualcomm/qualcomm-accuses-apple-of-stealing-its-secrets-to-help-intel-idUSKCN1M51RT), the filing alleges that Apple stole trade secrets "for the purpose of improving lower-quality modem chipsets, including those manufactured by Intel, a competitor of Qualcomm, to render such chipsets useable in Apple devices with the ultimate goal of diverting Qualcomm's Apple-based business to Intel." The filing is the latest move in a long-running legal dispute between the two companies. Apple and Qualcomm didn't immediately return MarketWatch's request for comment. Qualcomm shares are down 0.4% in Tuesday morning trading, while Apple shares are little changed and the S&P 500 is down 0.4%.
-Emily Bary; 0936ET
